messages.content: Patina is a field app for a municipal public-art conservation team: a collection of outdoor artworks, condition surveys with photo findings, and a treatment queue. Local-first, English and French.

Patina is an Uno Platform single-project app at Patina/Patina.csproj with a plain net10.0 class library at Patina.Core/Patina.Core.csproj (project reference) and NUnit tests in Patina.Tests.

**Key files:**
- Patina/App.xaml (+ .cs): Material theme resources generated from docs/DESIGN.md, hosting, and the route map (Shell -> Main -> Collection, Treatments, Settings tabs; Artwork, Survey and Treatment as full-screen siblings).
- Patina/Presentation/*.xaml (+ *Model.cs): one MVUX partial-record model per page (CollectionModel, ArtworkModel, SurveyModel, TreatmentsModel, TreatmentModel, SettingsModel).
- Patina/Controls/ArtworkMap.cs and MutedTileSource.cs: a Mapsui map with OpenStreetMap tiles re-coloured to the theme, condition-coloured pins.
- Patina/Strings/en and fr: .resw string tables generated from one table by tools/make_resw.py.
- Patina.Core/: domain records (Artwork, Survey, Finding, Treatment), the condition and scheduling rules, queries, and a JSON document store under ApplicationData.

**Patterns:**
- MVUX: models expose IFeed/IState/IListState; no INotifyPropertyChanged or ObservableCollection-as-state. Record SelectedItem does not round-trip through the MVUX proxy on ComboBox, so selection binds SelectedIndex.
- Uno.Extensions.Navigation with ViewMap/DataViewMap and typed data passing; the responsive shell switches NavigationView and TabBar with AdaptiveTrigger (ResponsiveExtension does not reconnect on cached pages, see docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md).
- Domain rules live in Patina.Core and are unit tested: the worst finding sets the grade, survey intervals depend on material and condition, submitting a survey proposes one treatment per serious or urgent finding.
- Photos: CameraCaptureUI on Android and iOS; FileOpenPicker on desktop and web.

The app is built and running. The user may ask me to modify it.
